record.a: Jingdezhen porcelain · Imperial Kiln Factory ware · 御窰廠
record.d: Porcelain from Jingdezhen, Jiangxi, China's largest porcelain centre since the 14th century, whose official kilns at Zhushan made imperial wares for the court from about 1369 until 1911.

v.d: after reconstruction of the official kilns

items.why: Product: Jingdezhen's ware types (Qingbai, blue and white, Kraak, famille) are already archetypes here, so only the imperial-kiln production, collected by reign, is added; the tableware house sits in B5.
Ambiguous resolved: the stitch technique is VE, but the embroidered pictures are bought, and 'Suzhou embroidery' (Su xiu) is already an archetype under Embroidered picture.
Already present: 'Wycinanki' (Polish paper cutting) is an archetype under Paper cut.
